items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: I believe it was in Louis Knops Bar, if I'm mistaken.

ctx.x: You remember where that rally was? What part of town was that rally in?
Well, they left from, I remember that well. They left that rally started from Legion Field in Dauphine. I believe it was in Louis Knops Bar, if I'm mistaken.
That's where the political rally started. Louis Knapp? Huh? Louis Knapp?
